items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: His wife is also a piano player.

ctx.x: He's still there. His wife is also a piano player. He's another personal friend of ours. It's just naturally when people are getting older, you know, they lose track of each other, you know. And I used to get out in the street every day and go to church, and every now and then I'd meet a lot of people I knew so good, you know. The children say, oh, mama, yeah, she'd go out, know so-and-so, you know, and all that.
Say, mom, what about the, uh, some of that stuff about the Lions Club and some of that stuff, you know?
